independent_research_claim.claim: Q-Eternal reports a 16-payment reorganization between 9 source accounts and 10 destination accounts over 2026-10-22 18:08:12–18:08:22 UTC.

custody_reorganization.reconciliation_note: The ten-destination table does not map the separate 600,000 XRP Advance Funding Subscribers tranche. The small residuals in the mapped buckets are not a substitute for a full six-tranche wallet reconciliation.

explorer_corroboration.observation: Each accessible page identifies the BitGo Initialization Wallet rD4G6gtD2KwHqsRf7pcyA8r1neUzXT61ix as activator and labels the account multisig; displayed balances align with the relevant large tranche buckets or small operational transfers.
explorer_corroboration.limitation: One destination page was inaccessible; the explorer's static extraction did not expose the full transaction history. Bithomp activation evidence corroborates BitGo account creation, not legal beneficial ownership.

custody_reorganization.transaction_count_reconciliation: NOT_RECONCILED: XRP Insights JSON lists 19 out-of-set movements over multiple dates; Q-Eternal describes a 16-payment batch in a narrower ten-second window. The scopes differ and must not be forced to match.

cantors_equity_facility_reconciliation.likely_explanation: The $80.7M summary figure is arithmetically consistent with the $15.46 October 22 XRPN close, while the cover/detailed gross figure uses the October 29 $14.71 close. This is a likely stale reference-price carryover, not a confirmed issuer explanation.
cantors_equity_facility_reconciliation.facility_terms: Optional company-directed equity line; Cantor purchases at 97% of applicable VWAP subject to conditions; potential maximum equals 16.7% of then-outstanding Class A shares if all registered shares issue; 4.99% beneficial ownership cap.
cantors_equity_facility_reconciliation.intended_use: General corporate purposes including XRP and ecosystem acquisitions; company expects a substantial portion of any proceeds to acquire XRP, but retains broad discretion.

confirmed_by_primary_filing: BitGo is Evernorth's primary XRP custodian.
The prospectus states 100% cold storage as of 2026-10-30.
The prospectus describes multisignature/HSM custody controls and one or more custody accounts.
The prospectus reports yield strategies and DeFi participation commenced following Closing, while saying material XRP ecosystem deployment was not anticipated before Q4 2026.
sourced_onchain_claims: XRP Insights reports 103,129,904.55 XRP in 13 attributed wallets and 370,346,663.23 XRP transferred outside that attribution set at ledger 108047946.
Q-Eternal reports a BitGo-created 2-of-3 multisig reorganization and tranche-aligned destination balances.
Bithomp confirms BitGo activation and multisig status for nine accessible destination accounts.
inference: The large out-of-set movement is strongly consistent with internal BitGo custody reallocation rather than sale or exchange deposit.
The $80.7M ELOC summary value likely retains the earlier $15.46 reference price.
unknowns: Beneficial owner/control of each destination account is not directly disclosed on-ledger.
Mapping of the separate 600,000 XRP advance-funding subscriber tranche.
Reason for the 200,137.78 XRP tracker arithmetic difference.
Whether the 5.2236M and 3.8462M tagged deposits are Evernorth acquisitions, contributions or another custody client's transfers.
Actual XRP amounts, protocols, counterparties and collateral status for yield strategies.
disconfirming_or_limiting_evidence: No destination account is publicly labeled Evernorth in the explorer pages reviewed.
No verified exchange deposit or sale was found in the reviewed custody-reorganization evidence.
The machine-readable tracker and rendered page expose different ledger cutoffs.
Q-Eternal's 16-transaction count and XRP Insights' 19 out-of-set movement records have different query scopes.
